name: Phoenix
subtitle: Elixir web framework
creator: Chris McCord
maintainer: Phoenix core team (sponsored by Fly.io and Dashbit)
description: A web framework on Elixir and the Erlang BEAM virtual machine, known for fault tolerance and huge concurrency. LiveView builds rich real-time interfaces rendered on the server over WebSockets with very little JavaScript.

concepts.explanation: Destructure and branch on data shapes.
Interactive UI driven from the server.

codeSamples.label: Elixir
codeSamples.code:
# lib/my_app_web/router.ex
scope "/", MyAppWeb do
  pipe_through :browser
  get "/posts", PostController, :index
end

# lib/my_app_web/controllers/post_controller.ex
defmodule MyAppWeb.PostController do
  use MyAppWeb, :controller

  def index(conn, _params) do
    render(conn, :index, posts: MyApp.Blog.list_posts())
  end
end
